ops.title: cookiesync's macOS helper: how does it pick up a new build after brew upgrade without a file hash? (Oct 28 2026)
ops.body: Owner picked: daemonkit owns it. daemonkit adds Installed(path, build string) Program (an executable a package manager keeps at a stable path; Ensure places nothing; the build is the version string). cookiesync's darwin open() and install Ensure the helper with Installed(<PATH alias>, version), matching its Linux path; synckit stops rendering helper LaunchAgents and keeps the label, the socket and uninstall removal; reposync's helper gets the same Ensure. Rejected: a cookiesync-only Health.Build check and Drain. Also, under ruling 0cfb108: synckitd's restageUpgrade/stageProgram digest comparison is replaced by Ensure with its own version on the PATH alias.
